why: Gamora never deals with the Grandmaster. Topaz captures her, and her fight is with Tony and later Thanos; it is Tony and Valkyrie who bring the Grandmaster down.
The Watcher only speaks to Riri, urging her to fight back; it is Riri who drains Beck's nanites. He and Beck never interact.
The Watcher only watches Natasha find Zola's file, and it is Strange who seals Zola away. They never meet or clash.
Howard is only part of the group that storms headquarters with Nebula. Korg is the one who takes out Yon-Rogg, and Howard never deals with him.
Rael never deals with Howard. He only worries that she could pull his liquor license, and Nebula alone confronts and chases her.
Tony only builds the device that Peggy fires at the court. It is Peggy who fights King Thor, and Sir Nicholas who takes his scepter.
Her clash is with the zombie Captain America, who has his own connection to her. The zombie Hawkeye bites Happy, and Sharon only puts down Happy.
Blade's fights are with Ghost and the zombie Thor, each with their own connection. He has no clash of his own with the zombie Avengers as a group.
Yelena only helps hold the North Institute against Okoye's horde as a whole. She has no clash of her own with the zombie Avengers.
Alexei's clash is with the zombie Captain America, who has his own connection to him, not with the group.
